newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens up in late trade before results.
newsitem.headline: Siemens up in late trade before results.

text.p: Siemens AG shares rose strongly in post-bourse trade on Friday as dealers said the market was expecting good results from the electrical and engineering group when it publishes first-half figures on April 23.
Siemens shares, which were largely flat in bourse trade, gained 1.46 marks to 89.38 by 1435 GMT in electronic dealings within a lower overall market.
Traders said a break-through above 90 marks was possible. More than two million shares in the stock changed hands, the second largest volume on the IBIS electronic trading system on Friday.
